candidates.statement: III. Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 These guidances refer to previously approved collections of information found in FDA regulations. These collections of information are subject to review by the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) under the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 (44 U.S.C. 3501– 3520). The collections of information in these guidances have been approved under OMB control number 0910–0672.
